title: Skill Flying Kick
wikitext:
{{expand}}
A [[Monk]] special attack. Flying Kick is trainable at level 30 and is used alongside [[Dragon Punch]] / [[Tail Rake]] as the main Monk special attacks. This is the last special attack for Monks in the classic era.


Damage starts at 50 and increases with skill.

== Classes ==

* [[Monk]] - Level 30 '''(Max 225)'''
